name: Vanguard
description: You stand at the front of every fight, holding the line so your allies don't have to. Enemies who try to slip past you find themselves locked in place.

name: Weaponmaster
description: You have mastered every weapon you have ever picked up, and you carry one you trust like a part of yourself. Your technique turns a simple swing into an art.

name: Warlord
description: You lead from the front, calling the shots and pointing your allies at the gaps. One shout from you can rally a broken line and turn a losing fight around.

name: Evoker
description: You study raw elemental magic and shape it into fire, lightning, and frost. Your spells hit harder than most, and you can bend the blast around your friends.

name: Rune Weaver
description: You have studied the art of magic but still prefer a more physical combat approach. You weave runes into your armor and weapons to give you an edge over non-magic combatants.

name: Scholar
description: You treat magic as a library to be mastered, collecting every secret you can find. You read omens, steal spells from your rivals, and forget nothing.

name: Hex Magic
description: You curse your enemies and make those curses linger. Your hexes spread from one victim to the next, until the very ground beneath them turns against them.

name: Blood Magic
description: You pay for power with your own blood, and you are always willing to pay. Your hexes drain life from your foes to heal the wounds your magic carves into you.

name: Fate Magic
description: You see the threads of fate and know which ones to pull. You twist luck in your favor, curse your enemies with doom, and slip out of fates meant for you.

name: Green Magic
description: You draw your magic from the wild green, letting things bloom or rot at your word. Vines snare your foes and the forest canopy hides you from sight.

name: Witch Knight
description: Where other witches whisper curses from the shadows, you carve them into your foes with steel. Your armor is black with hexes, and anything you've marked learns too late that it cannot escape you.

name: Oath of Ochre
description: You swore your oath to living things, the root and the leaf and the green that endures. Vines bind your foes and your strikes carry the strength of growing life.

name: Oath of Umber
description: You swore your oath to the dead and to the memory of those who passed on. You guide lost souls home and strike down those who cheat their way out of the grave.

name: Oath of Shadows
description: You swore your oath in the dark, bringing judgment where light cannot reach. You slip through shadows and strike before your enemies know they are hunted.

name: Oath of Starlight
description: You swore your oath to the distant stars and the cold void between them. You mark your foes with starlight and cut them down with blades edged in the dark beyond.

name: Shadowblade
description: You strike from the dark and are gone before the body hits the floor. Shadows bend to carry you, and in time they learn to fight beside you.

name: Venombound
description: You trust poison more than steel, mixing toxins that sap strength and cloud the mind. Your own blood has turned bitter from years of handling them.

name: Ghostwalker
description: You can become anyone, slipping into a stolen face and leaving no trace behind. When the job is done, even the people who saw you forget you were there.

name: Cavalier
description: You were raised in the saddle, and you and your mount fight as one. Your charges break lines and knock riders to the dirt.

name: Shieldbearer
description: You plant your shield and become the wall your allies hide behind. Charges break against you, and no one gets past while you stand.

name: Crownguard
description: You have sworn your life to protect someone greater than yourself. You challenge any who threaten your charge and will step in front of the blade meant for them.

name: Archer
description: You live and die by the bow, whether up close or from across the field. Your aim is patient and your arrows fall like rain on anyone who stands against you.

name: Tamer
description: You never hunt alone, with a loyal beast always at your side. The two of you move as one, sharing every target and guarding each other's backs.

name: Stalker
description: You blend steel and spellwork, fighting with a blade in each hand. You dart in and out of the fight, marking your prey with hexes your blades follow home.

name: Circle of the Root
description: You draw strength from deep roots, wrapping yourself in bark and holding enemies fast with the grasping earth. Trees open paths for you, and forests rise where you call them.

name: Circle of the Beast
description: You would rather fight with fang and claw than with spells. You take the shapes of beasts and elements alike, becoming the most dangerous predator in any fight.

name: Circle of the Season
description: You carry the turning year inside you, calling down storms, frost, or summer heat at will. Your power shifts with the seasons, and the weather answers your mood.

name: Frenzied
description: You fight in a howling blur, swinging faster the angrier you get. Every blow that lands on you only feeds the next wave of steel.

name: Ironhide
description: You don't dodge hits, you take them and keep walking. Your rage hardens your body until you stand like a mountain no one can move.

name: Bloodwake
description: You smell blood and it drives you forward. Every wound you open makes you stronger, and the fight only ends when the field runs red.

name: Way of the Tiger
description: You fight like a hunting cat, rushing in with sudden pounces and raking blows. You watch for weakness and strike the moment your prey falters.

name: Way of the Bear
description: You fight like a bear, grabbing hold and crushing the fight out of your foes. Your hide is thick, and once you have someone in your grip they are not getting out.

name: Way of Iron
description: You have trained your body until it is as hard as iron. Your fists break guards, crack armor, and send shockwaves through anything you hit.

name: Phalanx
description: You fight shoulder to shoulder with your allies, spears leveled in an unbroken line. Together you hold ground that no single warrior could.

name: Skyreach
description: You leap high over the battlefield and drop on your enemies from above. Your foes learn to fear the sky, because that is where your spear comes from.

name: Twinstrike
description: You wield a spear in each hand, striking and guarding in the same motion. Your paired points fill the air with steel, leaving foes nowhere safe to stand.

name: Lightbearer
description: You carry the light of the dawn and pour it out on the battlefield. Your radiance shields your allies and burns away anything that hides from the sun.

name: Binder
description: You are a warden against things that should not walk the world. You seal away evil spirits and hollow horrors with sacred circles and holy sigils.

name: Whisper
description: You serve a quieter faith, one of secrets spoken in the dark. Shadows carry your whispers, and every confession you hear becomes a debt you can collect.

name: Necromancer
description: You raise the dead to fight for you, from a single bone servant to a marching army. Death is not the end of your soldiers, only the start of their service.

name: Hollowmancer
description: You have dared to tame the hollow rot that devours magic and life. Your hungry pack spreads decay through your enemies and eats away at their spells.

name: Technomancer
description: You build your summons from scrap, gears, and stolen power. Your drones swarm the field and your iron machines march where flesh would fall.

name: Warsong
description: You sing on the front line, and your songs turn fear into fury. Your battle hymns keep your allies marching when everything else says run.

name: Loresong
description: You collect stories, languages, and secrets the way others collect coins. Your words cut as deep as any blade, and there is little you cannot learn to do.

name: Diresong
description: You sing the songs of mourning, and your notes toll like a funeral bell. Your music shelters the living and calls the end for those whose time has come.

name: Rite of the Archon
description: You bound an Archon, a warden of celestial law. Its chains answer your verdicts, pinning the guilty in place until sentence is passed.
breach_effect: One creature of the GM's choice within 30 ft (ally or enemy) is restrained until the end of its next turn (save ends, class DC).

name: Rite of the Seraph
description: You bound a Seraph, a six-winged burning choir. Its fire pours out of every crack in your seal and lifts you into the sky.
breach_effect: 10-ft burst centered on you: 3d8 radiant to every creature but you (Precision roll, class DC, half).

name: Rite of the Virtue
description: You bound a Virtue, a celestial of mercy. You spend its stolen grace to mend allies, turn aside doom, and drag the newly dead back to life.

name: Mark of Crossroads
description: Debuffs and trades. Your devil keeps a ledger: creatures that hurt you become Indebted, and you collect with interest.

name: Mark of Legion
description: Frontline tank. Your devil is a soldier of the infernal ranks; you hold the line and drill your allies to fight as one.

name: Mark of Possession
description: Possession, misdirection, control. Your devil whispers charms and terrors through you. Third caster (Confidence) from level 3.
spellcasting: Full caster from Reaver level 3, using Confidence; slots copied from the Songsmith (Shared Frame full-caster table). Possession spell list; soul brand is the focus.
